slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: Now, the colors. Eight bright animals, and eight new colors to learn. Here we go.

slides.title: Red
slides.transcript: Red. A little ladybug, round and red. Spot! Spot! Spot, spot, spot!

slides.title: Yellow
slides.transcript: Yellow. A soft yellow duckling. Peep! Peep! Peep peep peep!

slides.title: Blue
slides.transcript: Blue. A big blue whale, in the deep blue sea. Splaaaash! Sploooosh!

slides.title: Green
slides.transcript: Green. A little green frog, sitting on a leaf. Ribbit! Ribbit! Ribbit ribbit!

slides.title: Orange
slides.transcript: Orange. An orange tiger, with black stripes. Rrrroooaaar! Rrrroooaaar!

slides.title: Purple
slides.transcript: Purple. A purple butterfly, up and away. Flutter, flutter, flutter away!

slides.title: Pink
slides.transcript: Pink. A round pink pig, in the squishy mud. Oink! Oink! Oink oink oink!

slides.title: Brown
slides.transcript: Brown. A big brown bear, sleepy and slow. Grrrrrr... grrrrumble... grrrr!

slides.title: Rainbow
slides.transcript: Rainbow. Red, yellow, blue, green, orange, purple, pink and brown. All the colors, all together. Goodnight, little one.
